goal: DEPTH: sub-sections / config sections in real integration with the backend — raise real coverage and capability levels
must_build: Every page in ui-spec/azure/eventgrid.json (30 pages; nav: Overview, Multipurpose, Azure service events, Custom events, Partner events, Partner events - Publishers)
Backend: ARM Microsoft.EventGrid topics + event subscriptions; delivery if modeled
List / create / detail / edit / delete round-trips through the native API the SDK and CLI use
always: Every page wired to the native API on /_wire (no static data); liveness fixtures for every list/detail page
core/capabilities/azure/eventgrid.json: one entry per console section with an honest level + tests; tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py must pass
Capability feature ids MUST start with 'azure.' (e.g. 'azure.eventgrid.<section>') — ids share one namespace with the AWS registry
Read the 'Cloud lenses' section of consoles/AGENT-UI.md first — use this cloud's kit, not Cloudscape
note:
DEPTH PASS (the base console is merged). Goal: turn this service's sub-sections and config sections into REAL backend integrations. For EACH capability entry listed in `depth_targets` decide:
  BUILD — Vyomi can model it in the shared core (state + native API semantics): implement it in core/<svc>_core.py (and the offline route if offline lacks it), add conformance checks in tests/conformance/, raise the entry's level in core/capabilities/<cloud>/<svc>.json (not_simulated→limited/full, config_only→limited/full where now ENFORCED, limited→full where a limitation is removed), wire the console section to it with a UI↔native-API round trip in consoles/tests/smoke-<cloud>.mjs and a "live" fixture for any list/detail page.
  KEEP HONEST — only if it needs something a local simulator cannot run (a separate product, real hardware/network, billing, third-party identity): leave it NotSimulated and put the concrete reason in the entry's `limitations`.
Prefer behaviour that is ENFORCED (e.g. lifecycle rules actually expire objects, a DLQ really receives, a policy really denies) over config that is only stored. Real coverage must go UP; nothing may regress: fidelity ≥ 90%, every capability claim true on nano AND offline, smokes green. Do not edit consoles/honest-allowlist.json or .github/.
House rules: keep consoles/src/<cloud>/kit/Capability.jsx as on base (add JSON imports only), list the service ONCE in registry.js, register any NEW core in wasm/build_cores.py + wasm/nano-boot.js (own line, never inside a // comment) + core/nano_registry.py + core/nano_persist.py (tests/conformance/test_nano_core_manifest.py), unique variable names in the smoke files, 'Vyomi' as plain text, re-vendor with python3 wasm/build_cores.py, rebuild bundles, COMMIT your source.

depth_targets.title: "Open query" (Azure Resource Graph Explorer) and "Assign tags" bulk action on the Topics list
limitations: Azure Resource Graph and bulk tag assignment across resources are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Secondary toolbar actions on a topic's Activity log and Locks panels (Edit columns, Export, Insights, Feedback, pin/reset filters)
limitations: Column customization, log export/insights and portal feedback are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Dead-lettering and retry policy (max delivery attempts, event TTL, expiration time)
limitations: Vyomi stores and returns these settings exactly as configured (PUT/GET round-trip), but never enforces them — see azure.eventgrid.eventsubscriptions.delivery.

depth_targets.title: Event delivery (filter matching, pushing to the destination endpoint, retries, dead-lettering)
limitations: Vyomi stores topics and event subscriptions and returns them over the native ARM wire, but there is no publish/delivery runtime: no event is ever matched against a subscription's filters, pushed to its destination, retried, or dead-lettered.

depth_targets.title: Topic activity log
limitations: A simplified, generic ARM activity feed (create/update/delete on this resource), not the real Microsoft.Insights audit trail (callers, correlation ids, full operation metadata).

depth_targets.title: Access control (IAM) on a topic
limitations: Role assignments scoped to an individual resource are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Resource locks
limitations: Vyomi stores and returns locks exactly as configured (CanNotDelete / ReadOnly, notes) but never enforces them — writes and deletes on a locked resource are not blocked.

depth_targets.title: Alerts, metrics, diagnostic settings and logs on a topic
limitations: Metrics charts, alert rules, diagnostic-setting log routing and Log Analytics queries are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Diagnose and solve problems, Tasks, and Support + Troubleshooting
limitations: These portal troubleshooting and support tools are not modeled.

depth_targets.title: Export template (ARM template / Bicep / Terraform)
limitations: Generating an exportable ARM/Bicep/Terraform template for a resource is not modeled.
